sections.title: Functions & notation
facts: $f(a)$: replace every $x$ with $a$, in brackets.
$f(g(x))$: do $g$ first, then $f$. Usually $f(g(x)) \neq g(f(x))$.
$f^{-1}$ undoes $f$: to find $f^{-1}(y)$, solve $f(x) = y$.
$f(x + 1) \neq f(x) + 1$ and $f^{-1}(x) \neq \frac{1}{f(x)}$.
Given $f(2x + 1)$, find $f(7)$ by choosing $x$ so that $2x + 1 = 7$.

sections.title: Graphs & transformations
facts: $f(x) + k$: up $k$. $f(x - h)$: right $h$. $-f(x)$: flip over the $x$-axis. $f(-x)$: flip over the $y$-axis.
Slope $= \frac{y_2 - y_1}{x_2 - x_1}$; $y = mx + b$ crosses the $y$-axis at $b$.
Parallel: equal slopes. Perpendicular: slopes multiply to $-1$.
$ax + by = c$ has slope $-\frac{a}{b}$ and crosses the axes at $\frac{c}{a}$ and $\frac{c}{b}$.

sections.title: Absolute value
facts: $|x - c|$ is the distance from $x$ to $c$.
$|x - c| = d > 0$: $x = c \pm d$, and the solutions add to $2c$.
$|x - c| \leq d$: $c - d \leq x \leq c + d$, which holds $2d + 1$ integers.
$|x - a| + |x - b|$ is smallest, $|a - b|$, for $x$ between $a$ and $b$.
When $x$ is on both sides, check every answer in the original equation.

sections.title: Inequalities & AM–GM
facts: Multiplying or dividing by a negative flips the inequality.
$\frac{a + b}{2} \geq \sqrt{ab}$ for $a, b > 0$, with equality when $a = b$.
Fixed sum: largest product when equal. Fixed product: smallest sum when equal.
$x + \frac{k}{x} \geq 2\sqrt{k}$ for $x > 0$.
$(x - a)(x - b) < 0$ means $x$ is between $a$ and $b$.

sections.title: Floor, ceiling & piecewise
facts: $\lfloor x \rfloor$ rounds down, $\lceil x \rceil$ rounds up: $\lfloor -2.5 \rfloor = -3$.
$\lfloor x \rfloor = n$ means $n \leq x < n + 1$.
There are $\lfloor \frac{N}{k} \rfloor$ multiples of $k$ from $1$ to $N$.
Piecewise: decide which piece the input is in (watch $<$ vs $\geq$), then use that rule.
